target.title: refactor(qa): retire the standalone Matrix QA runtime
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Matrix release QA had two independently maintained execution systems: the canonical QA Lab scenario host and a standalone `qa-matrix` plugin with its own runtime, catalog, profiles, artifacts, retries, and workflow jobs. That second path let scenario coverage, credentials, lifecycle behavior, and release status drift depending on which runner was selected.

## Why This Change Was Made

Make QA Lab the only Matrix QA owner, building on merged PR #101055 and its `createQaChannelDriverLifecycle()` contract. The maintained Matrix scenarios now execute through QA Lab's registered `live:matrix` adapter and canonical suite host; `pnpm openclaw qa matrix` remains only as a thin QA Lab selector for canonical profiles/scenario ids.

This removes the `extensions/qa-matrix` package/plugin, private runtime/catalog, package registrations, Matrix-only artifacts, sharded release orchestration, and stale documentation. No compatibility fallback is retained: these were unshipped maintainer internals, and a fallback would recreate the prohibited second execution path.

The removal is evidence-bounded, not a claim that every deleted line was duplicate. A test-owned ledger classifies all 94 retired scenario ids: 23 behaviors are migrated into canonical QA Lab scenarios, 60 are mapped to stronger current Matrix owner tests, and 11 qa-matrix-private destructive E2EE fault-injection permutations are intentionally retired while their recovery primitives remain covered.

## User Impact

Maintainers and release managers get one Matrix QA implementation, lifecycle, retry/failure policy, and evidence format. `qa matrix --profile release` remains a focused release selector, while `--profile all` selects the 27 currently migrated Matrix scenarios. The exhaustive selector and manual workflow default to `mock-openai` because deterministic streaming and image scenarios require that provider mode; scheduled live-provider proof remains on the compatible release profile.

There is no shipped Matrix channel runtime change. Packaged OpenClaw releases continue to omit private QA Lab tooling.

## Evidence

- Dependency/base proof:
  - Rebased onto `origin/main` `08abf83a665970cf6523118685b4c8683f226e98`.
  - Merged #101055 commit `3175d8e7423de21235cc34c49080c9df83c3af2b` is an ancestor and supplies the sole channel-driver lifecycle seam.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwxmjfbpe4wbadn3yz6rhbh9` (`harbor-crayfish`):
  - Complete Matrix/provider focused tests: 248/248 passed.
  - Workflow contract: 43/43 passed.
  - Matrix + E2EE focused tests: 94/94 passed.
  - Private QA build: `OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1 pnpm build` passed.
  - #101055 lifecycle live test: 2/2 drivers passed across cold start, idempotent start, restart, stop, and resume.
  - `qa matrix --profile all --provider-mode mock-openai`: 27/27 scenarios passed.
  - Non-default `--sut-account matrix-sut` allowlist hot reload passed.
  - Exact rebased head focused proof: 51/51 CLI/runtime/workflow assertions passed, then `matrix-room-partial-streaming-preview` passed with `--provider-mode` intentionally omitted, proving the QA Lab-owned Matrix default resolves to `mock-openai`.
- Scenario migration guard:
  - 94/94 retired ids classified, with no missing or duplicate dispositions.
  - 23 live behaviors migrated, 60 mapped to maintained owner tests, and 11 private destructive E2EE fault-injection cases intentionally retired.
  - Exact-head owner proof: 337/337 Matrix assertions plus 7/7 QA Lab ledger/E2EE assertions passed.
- Fresh final Codex autoreview on exact head `836587dfc7e685b2db00751800da5dc2575db1ee`: clean, no accepted/actionable findings (confidence 0.72).
- Exact-head focused release Matrix run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28851981886 (target pinned by `expected_sha`).
- Exact-head full manual QA Live run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28851983469.
- Exact-head CI repairs: dependency triplet, test types, 47 focused assertions, actionlint, and zizmor passed on Testbox.
